title: Bonus Buy Bulk Change
subtitle: Change the engine rules of many Planned bonus buys at once. Preview the change, then apply it.

access.deniedTitle: No access to Bonus Buy Bulk Change
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Bonus Buy Maintenance grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

error.list: The bonus buys could not be loaded.
error.change: The bulk change could not be sent.

lock.tested: Tested: send it back to Planned first
lock.activated: Live at the tills: send it back to Planned first
lock.deactivated: Deactivated: send it back to Planned first
lock.notOms: A SAP bonus buy: never changed here
lock.unknown: Status unknown: open it in Bonus Buy Maintenance

form.title: Engine rules
form.hint: Every field starts on Leave: it stays as each bonus buy has it. Change only what you mean to.
form.listHint: Add and Remove keep each bonus buy's other codes. Separate codes with commas, spaces or new lines.
form.fixProblems: Fix the fields marked in the form first.

problem.score: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
problem.maxValue: Enter an amount of 0 or more.

batch.empty: Select the bonus buys to change first.
batch.overCap: Select at most {{cap}} bonus buys in one batch.
batch.mixedSalesArea: The selection mixes KSA and Bahrain bonus buys. A batch takes one sales area.

preview.stale: The selection or the form changed after this preview. Preview again before applying.

apply.needsPreview: Preview the current selection and form first.
apply.confirmBody_one: Save the change on {{n}} bonus buy? Refused and skipped bonus buys are not touched.
apply.confirmBody_other: Save the change on {{n}} bonus buys? Refused and skipped bonus buys are not touched.

result.refusedWhole: The whole batch was refused. Nothing was saved.

markTested.title: Mark Tested
markTested.fromApply_one: {{n}} Planned bonus buy saved by the last apply
markTested.fromApply_other: {{n}} Planned bonus buys saved by the last apply
markTested.empty: Select Planned bonus buys, or apply a change first.
markTested.notePlaceholder: Optional. One note for every bonus buy in the batch.
markTested.confirmBody_one: Mark {{n}} bonus buy Tested? It is checked again first, and refused if it fails.
markTested.confirmBody_other: Mark {{n}} bonus buys Tested? Each is checked again first, and the ones that fail are refused.
markTested.error: The bonus buys could not be marked Tested.
markTested.refusedWhole: The whole batch was refused. Nothing was marked Tested.
